The closest match is Causality by Abstraction, which uses LLMs to extract formal symbolic rules with temporal operators and delay semantics for multivariate time series, specifically to explain causal relations and delayed effects from simulator-generated data [1]. It also emphasizes closed-loop refinement and validation of the extracted causal rules across epidemic and building-energy simulators [1].

If you are looking more broadly for LLMs plus logic or causality, PCRLLM focuses on stepwise logical constraints for reasoning [9], while several other papers address causal discovery in time series without the rule-learning setup, such as causal semantic alignment for forecasting [2], temporal causal discovery [4], irregular time-series causal discovery [5], and simulator-based interventional causal discovery [8].
